site.title: Celadon · Smart mastering plugin
site.description: Celadon is a mastering plugin that runs four stages in a fixed order — BALANCE dynamic EQ, CLAY stereo clean-up, COLOR tone and glue, LIMIT true-peak limiting — while one GLAZE knob listens to the song and decides how far to push it. VST3 / AU for macOS (Apple silicon / Intel) and Windows x64.

nav.label: Main
nav.platforms: VST3 · AU · macOS 12+ (Apple silicon / Intel) · Windows 10 / 11 x64

footer.blurb: A personal mastering plugin that Max and a few friends use — not for sale. Four stages run in a fixed order: balance → stereo clean-up → colour → limit. GLAZE listens to the song first, then decides how far to push.
